respins.how_it_works:
RESPIN UNTIL YOU WIN FEATURE
 When two full vertical stacks of the same symbol hit, the reel that doesn't contain a symbol of the same type
 re-spins until you win. The stacks that initiated the feature remain in place until any winning combination hits.
 Special reels are in play during the feature.
